events.label: Anduril wins up to $2.9 billion Navy submarine contract

slots.name: contract value
slots.sentence: Anduril lands $2.9 billion Navy submarine shipyard contract

slots.name: shipyard investment
slots.sentence: The company is also investing $3.7 billion to scale a new shipyard at Sparrows Point, outside Baltimore, Maryland, slated to start operations in 2030 and create about 3,100 jobs.

slots.name: number of shipbuilders
slots.sentence: The massive vessels are built by General Dynamics Electric Boat and Huntington Ingalls Industries.

events.label: Trump announces Anduril Arsenal Two shipyard opening
Wes Moore says Trump blocked him from speaking at Baltimore event

slots.name: speaking exclusion
slots.sentence: "If the president of the United States wants to bring the circus into town and tell me that I'm not allowed to speak, when in fact, we were the ones who helped bring the deal, then I will let the circus be conducted while I go back to the work of the people of Maryland," Moore told reporters in a video posted on X by a Baltimore FOX 45 News reporter.

slots.name: investment facilitation duration
slots.sentence: Moore said he was involved in facilitating the investment for more than a year – but said he would be skipping the event because Trump barred him from delivering remarks.

slots.name: attendance invitation status
slots.sentence: The Baltimore announcement pitted the pair against each other once more, as the White House argued that Trump "graciously invited Governor Moore to attend today's event as a guest" and said it is "unfortunate that the Governor is now making a multi-billion-dollar announcement about himself by throwing a tantrum."

slots.name: event date
slots.sentence: Moore attended a debate for his reelection race earlier on Oct. 6 and was due to attend a ribbon cutting ceremony later in the day.
